description: Fictional Slack and knowledge inputs in portable interchange format.

messages.text: The sound stops when I drag the waveform back to the start, and the time display sits at 0:00. Task AUD-741, Firefox 132. It played the first time.
Can you send the task ID and browser build? We need a second reproduction before filing.
AUD-741, Firefox 132.0.2. Reopening restores it until I seek again.
Reloading gives me one listen. As soon as I move the scrubber, the play triangle changes but the clock never advances. AUD-754, Chrome 131.0.6778.85.
I reproduced the stuck clock on that task. The downloaded WAV plays normally.
Anyone else getting the endless spinner after using jump-back? AUD-768, Firefox 132.0.2. This is after playback already worked.
Please keep the affected task open and add browser and task details to one report.
AUD-777 has no audible sound from the start. The timer moves normally to the end. The local download is completely silent as well. Where should I record that?
The download was also silent for me. Use the media-input quality flag and keep the original clip attached.
My clip is labeled 'field sample' but has a flat waveform in the file I downloaded. The counter plays through 00:11 and seeking works. I left this one ungraded. Is that the right route?
Can you share its task ID before we confirm the disposition?
For the bilingual rubric, do I still put a reviewer note under the two-line alignment check? The older help page says everyone should use the note.
The October change may apply here. Is this task currently assigned, or from the archive?
The note field is still there on JA-318. This was assigned today in the current review queue. Can I leave it blank when the alignment check passes?
Please confirm the batch code from the task metadata so we can apply the right rule.
For archive export JA-240, the second-line alignment passes. The announcement says notes are exception-only. Does that also change how I annotate this legacy export?
The export header says multi_batch_09. Keep the old note format for that archive; the new instructions cover the current batch.
Candidate B has two extra blank lines between bullets. Otherwise both answers say exactly the same thing and there is no output format restriction. Should I prefer A?
Pick Tie. Extra whitespace alone does not affect preference when there is no format requirement.
One answer begins with a blank line and one doesn't. They are otherwise identical. Does that change the label?
Use Tie for this item. The task doesn't specify exact serialization.
Does the archived reviewer activity counter include practice tasks reopened after midnight? This is for queue Q-31, activity view, not the scoring rubric.
I haven't found a definition for the archived counter. Has the owner published a spec?
The archive activity view shows 17 for yesterday. Two practice tasks were reopened after midnight. Are they part of that number?
Send a screenshot and the reporting time zone so we can ask the dashboard owner.
In the bilingual review export log, the Vietnamese diacritic is replaced with a question mark in the downloaded CSV. It looks correct in the browser preview. Export EX-51.
Please save the original export and the application name you opened it with. We haven't established where the change happens.
My CSV for EX-67 displays a missing accent in one editor, but the web preview still has it. I haven't checked any other editor yet.
Download it from Export History and keep the original file. Please try a UTF-8 editor and report whether the downloaded text still differs.

October update for multi_pilot_17: on newly assigned two-line alignment tasks, a reviewer note is required only if the two lines disagree. Archived multi_batch_09 exports retain the old always-note format. See Multilingual alignment review guide v2.0, section Reviewer notes.

knowledge_documents.title: Audio incident triage
knowledge_documents.text: For a reproducible player freeze after seeking, collect task IDs, browser versions, and reproduction steps. Send one scoped engineering incident for the affected player reports. If a downloaded clip is silent while the player counter and seeking work, follow the media-input quality procedure for that clip.

knowledge_documents.title: Media-input quality FAQ
knowledge_documents.text: If a local copy is confirmed to be silent and the player advances normally, preserve the sample and use the media-input quality flag. When the task ID or the local playback check is missing, ask for it before assigning a disposition.

knowledge_documents.title: Multilingual alignment review guide
knowledge_documents.text: Record a reviewer note on every two-line alignment check in this version. This format remains applicable to exports from multi_batch_09.

knowledge_documents.title: Multilingual alignment review guide
knowledge_documents.text: For newly assigned tasks in multi_pilot_17, record a reviewer note only when the two lines disagree. Archived multi_batch_09 exports retain the always-note format from v1.4.

knowledge_documents.title: Response preference scoring guide
knowledge_documents.text: When content is otherwise equivalent, whitespace alone does not break a tie. If a task specifies an exact serialized format, evaluate conformance to that requirement. This guide covers preference decisions.

knowledge_documents.title: Review export troubleshooting
knowledge_documents.text: For CSV character differences, preserve the downloaded file and compare the original bytes or a UTF-8-aware rendering with the web preview. Record the export ID and viewer. Until the original is checked, keep the cause open.
